evals.expected_output: Export is blocked before DOCX creation and reports E_EXPORT_APPROVAL with explicit missing-consent evidence.
assertions: The output does not create or claim a DOCX artifact.

evals.prompt: Run export with approval=true after all source and publication gates pass.
evals.expected_output: The export flow produces a manifest and a structurally valid DOCX with source provenance and reader-facing cleanliness checks.
assertions: The output manifest records status EXPORTED or an equivalent successful export state.
The DOCX header is validated as a ZIP package beginning with PK.
word/document.xml exists in the DOCX archive.
The exported content is checked against current episode source snippets.
Validator metadata, run IDs, blocker lists, and publication review warnings are not inserted into reader-facing DOCX text.
